overloaded.text: Deal +2 DMG for this instance; when targeting an active character, the target will be forcibly switched to the next character

superconduct.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target

electro_charged.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target

frozen.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance. The target character receives the Frozen status: The character cannot use Skills (Lasts until the end of this Round). When receiving Pyro or Physical DMG, the character receives +2 DMG and removes this status in advance.

swirl.text: Deal 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing characters except the target

crystallize.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance, grant 1 Shield point to your active character (Shield can be stacked. Max 2 points).

burning.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance and create a [Burning Flame]: End Phase: Deal 1 Pyro DMG. (1 Usage. Max 2 stacks)

bloom.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance and create a [Dendro Core]: When you deal Pyro DMG or Electro DMG to an opposing active character, DMG dealt +2. (1 Usage)

quicken.text: Deal +1 DMG for this instance and create a [Catalyzing Field]: When you deal Electro DMG or Dendro DMG to an opposing active character, DMG dealt +1. (2 Usages)
